_comment: Funding sources read by /prospect-funding. Add more entries as the team finds them; each needs a matching section in skills/prospect-funding/references/sources.md.

sources.name: Fundup AI feed
sources.notes: Logged-in feed; the rep's saved filters (signal window, country, ICP match, etc.) persist on their account, so load the URL as-is and do not change filters. Run on demand throughout the day; funding-seen.json dedupes repeat scans. Cards give company, round, amount, investors, size, industry, a summary and an ICP badge, but no domain or founders.

sources.name: FinSMEs
sources.notes: Cloudflare-protected: script fetches and /feed return 403. Read in the rep's Chrome only. Articles include HQ, description, round, amount, lead investor, CEO name, and a link to the company website.
